name: Noyau abducens
summary: The abducens nucleus lies under the facial colliculus in the caudal pons and is the horizontal gaze center's output stage: its motor neurons supply the ipsilateral lateral rectus, and its internuclear neurons cross in the MLF to drive the contralateral medial rectus. name: Amygdale (complexe amygdalien)

name: Commissure antérieure
summary: The anterior commissure is a compact bundle of crossing fibers in the front wall of the third ventricle, in front of the columns of the fornix and below the rostrum of the corpus callosum, connecting the two temporal lobes, the amygdalae and the olfactory regions. summary: A single midline artery formed by the union of a branch from each vertebral artery that descends along the whole length of the cord in the anterior median fissure. summary: Tufts of arachnoid that push through the dura into the venous sinuses, chiefly the superior sagittal sinus and its lateral lacunae, and act as one-way valves returning CSF to the blood when CSF pressure exceeds venous pressure by a few centimetres of water. name: Aire de Broca
summary: Partie postérieure du gyrus frontal inférieur de l'hémisphère dominant (pars opercularis et pars triangularis). name: Area postrema
summary: The area postrema is a small, highly vascular strip of tissue on each side of the caudal floor of the fourth ventricle, at the obex, lacking a blood–brain barrier so that its neurons sample the blood and CSF directly. name: Aire de Wernicke

name: Artères lenticulostriées
summary: A fan of small perforating arteries that rise from the first segment of the middle cerebral artery (lateral lenticulostriates) and from the proximal anterior cerebral artery (medial lenticulostriates, including the recurrent artery of Heubner), pierce the anterior perforated substance and supply the putamen, globus pallidus, caudate and the internal capsule. name: Artères pontiques

name: Artère d'Adamkiewicz
summary: The largest of the anterior radicular arteries that reinforce the anterior spinal artery. name: Artère cérébelleuse antéro-inférieure (AICA)
summary: Branche du basilaire inférieur gagnant l'angle pontocérébelleux, donnant habituellement l'artère labyrinthique. Elle vascularise le pont latéral caudal, le pédoncule cérébelleux moyen, le flocculus et la face antéro-inférieure du cervelet.

name: Artère choroïdienne antérieure
summary: A slender but strategically important branch of the internal carotid that arises just before the terminal bifurcation, runs backwards along the optic tract, and ends in the choroid plexus of the temporal horn. name: Artère basilaire
summary: Formée par l'union des artères vertébrales au bord inférieur du pont, l'artère basilaire monte dans le sillon médian du pont jusqu'à son bord supérieur où elle se divise en deux artères cérébrales postérieures. Elle donne en chemin les artères cérébelleuses antéro-inférieures, labyrinthique, pontiques et cérébelleuses supérieures.

name: Artère carotide interne

name: Artère labyrinthique (auditive interne)

name: Artère ophtalmique

name: Artère cérébrale postérieure (ACP)
summary: Branches terminales de l'artère basilaire. Chaque artère cérébrale postérieure contourne le mésencéphale en donnant des perforantes thalamiques et mésencéphaliques et des branches choroïdiennes, puis s'étale sur le lobe temporal inféromédial et tout le lobe occipital dont le cortex calcarin.

name: Artère communicante postérieure
summary: A short vessel running backwards from the supraclinoid internal carotid to join the posterior cerebral artery, linking the anterior and posterior circulations on each side. name: Artère cérébelleuse postéro-inférieure (PICA)

name: Artère cérébelleuse supérieure (SCA)

name: Artère vertébrale
